questions: Describe your country’s geography for me. Are there mountains, lakes, or rivers? What is your country like?
Tell me a little bit about a country close to your own country. Tell me what the country looks like, about its people and some of its traditions.
이웃 국가의 국민 성향과 전통 묘사
Tell me about the outdoor activities that are popular in your country. Do people go hiking, bike or swim? What do people typically do outdoors?
우리나라 사람들의 보편적인 야외 활동 묘사
Please tell me about what kinds of free time activities people in your country do.
우리나라 사람들이 시간이 날 때 하는 활동 묘사
I’d like you to pick a favorite place in your country from your childhood and describe that place for me. What are your memories of that place? What was it like when you were a child?
어렸을 때 가장 좋아했던 우리나라 장소 묘사
Tell me about an early memory of your country’s geography. Perhaps, you visited a special place or went to an important natural landmark. Describe what you saw when you visited that special place.
어렸을 때 기억나는 지형 관련 추억 묘사

People often have memorable and moving experiences when they explore their country’s geography. You might climb a famous mountain or swim at a beautiful beach. Tell me the story of a memorable time you had while visiting a natural place in your country.
지형 관련해서 본인이 가 본 국내 장소 추억 묘사
How has your country changed in the past decade? Choose one area of change and provide a lot of details about urban development, tourism, or any other area.
우리나라가 지난 10년간 겪은 변화 중 하나 설명

Tell me in detail about changes you have observed concerning the relationship between your country and other countries. The change might be related to the economy, sports, arts, culture or politics. Describe the changes in detail.
우리나라와 다른 국가와의 관계와 관계 변화 설명

I’d like you to think about a specific historic event that has affected the relationship between your country and one of its neighboring nations. It could be a treaty signed between two countries, a cultural event or the visit of another country’s minister or president. Tell me in detail about everything that happened.
우리나라와 이웃 국가와의 역사적 사건과 파장 설명
What do people usually do on the Internet? Do they play games, watch television, etc? Talk about the things people do online in detail.
사람들이 주로 인터넷으로 하는 일들 묘사
What are your usual habits when you are online? Do you usually share videos, do your shopping, read the news, etc? What do you usually do online?
본인이 주로 인터넷으로 하는 일들 묘사
Tell me about your typical routine online. What do you do? Tell me about your online activities.
본인이 일상적으로 인터넷상에서 하는 일들 묘사
Tell me about your favorite website or type of website you visit. Why do you like it? Give me as many details as you can.
본인이 가장 좋아하는 웹사이트를 묘사하고 좋아하는 이유 설명
What kinds of videos do you like to watch online for fun, for work or for school? Tell me about the kinds of videos you like to watch online.
본인이 인터넷에서 주로 보는 동영상 묘사

When did you first become interested in surfing the Internet? Tell me about your first experience or experiences of surfing the Internet in great detail. What were your first impressions of it? What do you remember about it?
본인의 초창기 인터넷 서핑 경험 묘사

Tell me about a project that you worked on that involved doing research on the Internet. Start with giving me some background about the project: when and where it was. And then, tell me how you used the Internet to get the project done.
리서치를 해야 했던 프로젝트에서 인터넷을 활용한 방법 설명
Describe something memorable you saw online for work or for leisure. Maybe it was something impressive, unusual, humorous or meaningful for you. What did you notice about it? What made it special?
What kinds of concerns do people have about Internet use regarding security, privacy or safety? How have these concerns changed over time? Please discuss this in more detail.
How does Internet usage vary among people of different age groups from old to young? Why do they use the Internet? What do they do online? Please discuss this in more detail.
sets: p.195: yesterday's online activities appears only in the SET table; the English prompt is missing from pp.195-197. Not replaced with a present-tense routine.

questions: What do you like most about your phone? Do you like the camera? Do you like a certain application? Do you like a game that is on your phone? Tell me why you like that feature.
본인 전화기의 가장 좋아하는 기능 묘사

What do you and your friends do on your phones besides talking to each other over the phone? Do you make updates on your social media pages? Do you play games? Tell me what you typically do on your phone.
전화 통화 외에 전화기로 주로 하는 일 묘사
Tell me about the first phone you used. How was it? How was it different from the phone you are using now?
본인이 썼던 첫 전화기와 지금 전화기 비교

Some features and services on phones are easy to use. But you may have to get help from friends, family or the service providers for certain features, battery problems or other phone services. Tell me about a time when you had a problem using your phone. What was the problem and how did you deal with the situation?
본인의 전화기 사용 중 겪었던 문제 설명

Describe how people used cell phones five years ago. What could they do with their phone functions and applications? What are some of the biggest changes as to how people use their phones? Describe the phone you used to use in the past in detail.
사람들의 휴대전화 이용 방식 5년 전과 지금 비교

In some societies, there is a concern that young people are not developing face-to-face communication skills because they spend too much time on their phones. What do people in your country think about the way in which young people use their phones?
젊은이들의 휴대전화 과다 사용 부작용 설명
Tell me about the kinds of things you and your friends talk about on the phone.

I’d like to know about your routine of talking on the phone. Who do you talk with, when do you usually talk on the phone and how long do you talk for? Do you do other things at the same time when you are on the phone?
본인의 전화 통화 습관 묘사 (상대, 시점, 통화 길이, 함께 하는 일)

How did you choose the phone that you currently use? How did you hear about it? Did you do research? Tell me everything you can remember about your experience of choosing your phone from beginning to end.
본인의 지금 전화기 기종 선택 이유 설명

Can you tell me about a memorable phone conversation you had using your phone? Maybe your friend or your relative told you some exciting news. Maybe something funny happened while you were on the phone. Tell me about that story from beginning to end with lots of details about why it was so memorable.
본인 기억에 남는 전화 통화 설명
What kind of technology do people typically use in your country? Do people use computers, cell phones, or hand-held devices? What are some common forms of technology that people have?
우리나라 사람들이 보편적으로 사용하는 기술 묘사
Tell me about a piece of technology that you use every day. What kind of things do you use it for?
본인이 매일 가장 자주 사용하는 기술 묘사

Technology has definitely changed over time. Tell me about an early memory that you have about a piece of technology. It could be a computer or a mobile phone from many years ago. Describe for me what this thing was like back then. How has that technology changed over time?

Problems often come up because of our dependence on technology. Think about a time when you experienced a problem because some piece of technology was not working properly. Maybe your computer crashed or maybe your cell phone had no service. Tell me about a time when you had some kind of problem getting your technology to work.
어떤 기술에 문제가 있어서 본인이 겪은 불편 묘사

Tell me about one industry in your country that is well-known. You can talk about any industry such as the entertainment, technology, automotive industry or other industries. Pick one industry and tell me all about it.
우리나라에 잘 알려진 산업 분야 묘사
Can you tell me about one promising or famous company in this particular industry? Tell me how the company started, and all the things that have happened that made it become so well- known.
방금 언급한 산업에서 잘 알려진 저명한 기업 묘사

When this company introduced its most important products, were they successful right away? Describe to me the challenges this company faced and how the company was able to succeed. Tell me in as much detail as you can.
방금 언급한 기업의 성공 과정과 난관 극복 과정 설명
What are some of the companies that young people want to work for these days? Why do young people want to work for these companies?
요즘 젊은이들이 들어가고 싶어 하는 기업들 묘사

Describe a company or industry in your country that is attractive to workers. When did this company or industry start? How has it become successful? What has made this company or industry so attractive to workers?
사람들이 매력을 느끼는 기업 혹은 산업 묘사
What kinds of efforts have you made for your career in the past? Tell me about some individual efforts that you have made for your career.
본인 진로를 위해 한 노력들 묘사
What do people usually do to prepare for their future careers? How do they learn about the different types of industries and how do they get ready to apply for those jobs?
사람들이 자신의 진로를 위해 하는 노력들 묘사

Can you tell me about an industry that you follow? Maybe you are interested in the food industry, energy, mobile computing or another industry. What was this industry like three years ago? How has it changed since then?
본인이 관심 갖고 있는 업계 설명. 3년 전과 비교

Tell me about a time that a product did NOT meet the expectations of the public. Maybe the gaming industry produced a new video game platform that did not perform well or a new smartphone or a software program had problems when it was first released. Tell me all about what happened in detail and describe the reactions of the public and the industry to that issue.
그 관심 업종에서 기대에 못 미친 상품/서비스 묘사

How do people prepare for future work in your country’s industries? Do they get general education first or receive specific training once they join the company? Do they receive specific job training from a young age? How has the process changed over the past five years? Give me all the details.
사람들이 자신의 진로를 위해 하는 노력. 5년 전과 비교
What is an industry or a company that people in your country are talking about nowadays? Tell me why people are interested in this industry and what they are saying about it. Give me lots of details.
우리나라 사람들이 관심을 갖는 업계 설명
Tell me about the weather in your country. Are there different seasons? What is the weather typically like?
Tell me about the weather at where you are today. What is happening right now?
How has the weather in your country changed over time? What was the weather typically like when you were a child? How was the weather different from the weather today?
어렸을 때 날씨와 최근 날씨 비교

Severe weather can often cause serious problems. Tell me about an experience you had when the weather created some kind of problems. Maybe roads were flooded, maybe schools and businesses were closed due to snow or cold weather conditions. Tell me about an experience you had when severe weather created some kind of problem. Give me lots of details.
Tell me about how people typically get around in your country. Do people drive their own cars or do they use trains or buses? What are some typical means of transportation?
What means of transportation do you use to get around? Do you drive or take public transportation?
How did you travel when you were a child? Were the types of transportation different back then? Describe for me how people used to get around in your city or town.

Problems often arise related to transportation. Cars break down, trains run late, or there are traffic jams. Tell me about a transportation problem that you once faced. Tell me everything that happened and what you did to deal with the situation.
교통편 사용 중 본인이 겪은 문제 설명
